routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

name: Calculate Leave Balance
description: Calculates the current available leave balance for an employee by retrieving allocations, processing leave requests, and computing remaining balance across all leave types

inputVariables.name: employeeId
inputVariables.description: Unique identifier of the employee whose leave balance needs to be calculated

inputVariables.name: calculationDate
inputVariables.description: Date for which to calculate the balance (defaults to current date)

inputVariables.name: leaveTypeId
inputVariables.description: Optional specific leave type ID to calculate balance for (if empty, calculates all types)

data.label: Start
data.description: Initiate leave balance calculation process

data.label: Validate Employee
data.description: Verify employee exists and is active in the system

data.label: Retrieve Leave Allocations
data.description: Fetch all leave allocations for the employee from LeaveAllocation table

data.label: Retrieve Leave Requests
data.description: Fetch all approved and pending leave requests for the employee up to calculation date

data.label: Calculate Balance
data.description: Compute available balance by subtracting used/pending leaves from allocations for each leave type

data.label: Balance Changed?
data.description: Check if calculated balance differs from last recorded balance

data.label: Update Leave Balance
data.description: Update LeaveBalance table with new calculated balances

data.label: Record Balance History
data.description: Create audit record in LeaveBalanceHistory for tracking changes

data.label: Notify Employee
data.description: Send notification to employee about updated leave balance

data.label: Return Balance Data
data.description: Prepare final balance data for output

data.label: End
data.description: Leave balance calculation completed successfully

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.

routing.reasoning: This is a classic two-level approval workflow with 7-8 nodes including decision points, notifications, and balance updates. ApprovalWorkflowExpert is optimal for manager+HR approval patterns. SQLExpert handles relational data (employees, leave types, balances, approvals). AdvancedFormExpert manages complex validation (date ranges, balance checks, conditional fields). CrossPlatformExpert ensures mobile access for all user roles. Ensemble strategy combines workflow, forms, and data expertise for comprehensive solution.
